critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED by tester: /app/frontend/src/components/RipplePoster.jsx used `useEffect` without importing it (only useRef/useState were imported). This would throw ReferenceError as soon as the Ripple Poster component mounted (line 207). ESLint confirmed `'useEffect' is not defined (no-undef)`. Added useEffect to the import; poster + format toggle now regenerate correctly for both 4:5 and 9:16.
server.py seed_flagship() sets total/verified totals but leaves goal_target unset (falsy) on puntland — expected, but consider seeding a sample goal_target for demo (optional).

TartanView passes `stats?.verified_members ?? tartan.verified_members` to GoalMeter — matches the docstring 'current=verified_members'. Consistent with backend `verified_organizer = verified_members>=25`.
Notifications endpoint creates ancestor notifications for up to 3 nearest ancestors on every join; consider deduping / TTL if chains grow to thousands of joins/hour (not blocking).

Chain 'streak' only inspects the first 50 directs (sort desc by created_at, limit 50). If a member had a burst of >50 directs on a single recent day, historical streak days would be truncated. Low probability but a note.

rca of the issue: RipplePoster.jsx: `useEffect(() => { if (open) { ... } }, [format])` was calling an undefined identifier because the import statement omitted useEffect. Root cause: partial refactor when adding the format state that introduced a new effect but did not update the destructured React imports. Reproduction: click export-poster-button on /me/{share} — component would throw at render. Mitigation: added useEffect to import list; ESLint clean; verified in browser (both format buttons regenerate a valid data:image/png).
